en.name: Agar, dried
en.summary: Dried agar — strips, sticks or powder — is essentially pure dried polysaccharide from seaweed, with almost no fat or protein to go rancid. Sealed and dry it is one of the longest-keeping things in the cupboard: 1–2 years. A set agar jelly is an ordinary prepared food and keeps 5–7 days refrigerated.
en.pantry: Keep it away from heat, direct sunlight and damp, in a sealed container, and it runs 1–2 years. There is very little in agar for anything to attack: no oil to oxidise, no protein to break down, and no water to support growth. What actually ends a packet is moisture — powder cakes, strips go limp and lose their setting power — or the container being left open long enough for it to take up kitchen smells. Store powder and strips the same way, and keep the packet flat so you can see how much is left.
en.fridge: The refrigerated figure is for a set agar jelly rather than the dry product: covered, at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, 5–7 days. Agar sets and holds at room temperature, unlike gelatine, which tempts people to leave a jelly on the counter — but a sweetened jelly, often with fruit or milk in it, spoils exactly like any other prepared food, and the fact that it has not melted tells you nothing. Cover it so the surface does not dry and skin over.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for agar, and there is no point in either direction. The dry product already keeps for years in a cupboard, and a set agar jelly freezes badly: the gel structure ruptures and thaws weeping and grainy, leaving you with syrup and rubbery fragments. Make the amount of jelly you will eat within the week instead.
spoilage: Powder that has caked into hard lumps, or strips gone soft and limp — it has taken up moisture.
A musty smell, or any visible mould in the packet.
Agar that no longer sets properly, which means it has been stored damp.
A set jelly that smells sour, has weeping liquid, or shows mould at the surface.
tips: Keep the packet sealed and away from the stove and the sink.
Weigh agar rather than measuring by spoon; strips and powder set very differently.
Cover a set jelly in the fridge so the surface does not skin.
Do not leave an agar jelly on the counter just because it holds its shape there.

faq.q: How long does dried agar keep?
faq.a: 1–2 years sealed in a cool, dry, dark cupboard. It has almost no fat or protein, so very little can go wrong.

faq.q: How long does an agar jelly keep?
faq.a: 5–7 days covered in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. It spoils like any other prepared food even though it holds its shape at room temperature.
It is not worth doing. The gel ruptures and thaws weeping and grainy.

zh.name: 洋菜（乾）
zh.summary: 乾洋菜——不論是條狀、棒狀或粉狀——基本上是海藻來的純乾燥多醣，幾乎不含會走油耗的油脂或蛋白質。密封乾燥保存，它是櫥櫃裡最耐放的東西之一：1～2 年。凝好的洋菜凍則是一般的調理食品，冷藏 5～7 天。
zh.pantry: 遠離高溫、陽光直射與濕氣，裝在密封容器裡，可放 1～2 年。洋菜身上幾乎沒有東西可供攻擊：沒有會氧化的油、沒有會分解的蛋白質，也沒有能支持微生物生長的水分。真正終結一包洋菜的是濕氣——粉會結塊，條狀會變軟、失去凝固力——或是容器敞太久、吸進了廚房的氣味。粉和條的保存方式相同；包裝平放，才看得出還剩多少。
zh.fridge: 冷藏的數字指的是凝好的洋菜凍，不是乾貨：加蓋、放 4 °C 以下，5～7 天。洋菜和吉利丁不同，在室溫下也能凝固定型，這讓人很容易把凍留在檯面上——但一份加了糖、常常還加了水果或牛奶的凍，腐敗方式和其他調理食品一模一樣，「它還沒融化」什麼也證明不了。請加蓋，表面才不會乾掉結皮。
zh.freezer: 這裡沒有給洋菜的冷凍期限，而且兩邊都沒有意義。乾貨本來就能在櫥櫃放好幾年；凝好的洋菜凍則非常不耐凍：膠體結構會被破壞，解凍後出水又帶顆粒，最後只剩下糖水和一塊塊橡皮。不如一次只做這一週吃得完的量。
spoilage: 粉結成硬塊，或條狀變軟垂軟——代表它吸了水。
聞到霉味，或包裝內看得見霉。
怎麼煮都凝不起來，代表它是在潮濕環境下存放的。
凝好的凍聞起來發酸、出水，或表面長霉。
tips: 包裝密封，遠離爐火和水槽。
用秤的而不是用湯匙量；條狀和粉狀的凝固力差很多。
冷藏的凍要加蓋，表面才不會結皮。
不要因為洋菜凍在室溫也不會化，就把它留在檯面上。

faq.a: 密封放陰涼乾燥避光的櫥櫃 1～2 年。它幾乎沒有油脂和蛋白質，能出問題的地方很少。
加蓋放 4 °C 以下冷藏 5～7 天。就算它在室溫也不會化，腐敗方式仍和其他調理食品相同。
不值得。膠體會被破壞，解凍後出水又帶顆粒。
